caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned at an angle, facing slightly to the right. The chair features a decorative backrest with intricate carved patterns made of interlaced circular and curved shapes, rising from the seat to a gently arched top rail. The wood of the chair has a medium brown color with visible grain detailing. The seat is upholstered in a muted green fabric, with a yellow-gold trim along the bottom edge. The legs are straight, with the front legs positioned vertically and the rear legs continuing upward to form the frame of the backrest. Crossbars connect the legs near the base, forming a sturdy rectangular support structure. The background is plain and unadorned, consisting of a solid off-white or cream color, which contrasts with the colors of the chair and makes it the clear focus of the composition.
title: Side Chair
